StoryDetails: Back in 2020, we started asking ourselves a straightforward question that might later become our mission: Why is it still difficult to hire an honest and skilled plumber? An excellent carpenter? Or any reliable professional? Within the era of an instant-everything, you should not have to struggle, waste time researching a pro, calling and comparing pros by yourself, waste money and resources to redo what was supposed to be done once by a pro. Therefore we set out to make it easier. In the near future, innumerable customers should be able to use MosalaPro technology to search out and hire professionals around the African continent.

FAQDescription: For questions, please browse the frequently asked questions below, if you are still not satisfied with the answers or don't find the category you need help with, feel free to leave us a message, click on the button below.
FAQHowItWorksAnswer: MosalaPro is the largest african service provider platform that enables both service providers and users to meet their goals. Search for service providers who are needed for your project, message them, get a quote and approve the quote offer. In case it is hard to find an appropriate service provider, or there's no time to find go through the search result, just post your service request and let service providers apply for it.
FAQJoinAsUser: How do you join MosalaPro as a user?
FAQJoinAsUserAnswer: To join MosalaPro as a user, follow these steps:
FAQAccessRegistrationDetails: Click on the "Create an account" option, typically located at the top right corner of the homepage.
FAQChooseAccountTypeDetails: Select the "USER" option to register as a user.
FAQCompleteFormDetails: Fill in the required details, which may include your name, email address, and password.
FAQSubmitInfoDetails: After completing the form, submit your information to create your account.
FAQJoinAsProvider: How do I join MosalaPro as service provider?
FAQJoinAsProviderAnswer: To join MosalaPro as a service provider, follow these steps:
FAQAccessRegistrationProviderDetails: Click on the "Create an account" option, typically located at the top right corner of the homepage.
FAQAccountTypeProviderDetails: Select the "PROVIDER" option to register as a service provider.
FAQCompleteFormProviderDetails: Fill in the required details, which may include your name, contact information, and a description of the services you offer.
FAQAwaitApprovalDetails: After submitting your application, the MosalaPro team will review your information. Once approved, your profile will be active, allowing clients to find and hire you for their projects.
FAQSubmitRequest: How do I submit a service request?
FAQSubmitRequestAnswer: To submit a service request on MosalaPro, follow these steps:
FAQSearchProvidersDetails: Use the platform to find professionals suited to your project's needs.
FAQContactProvidersDetails: Message potential service providers directly through the platform to discuss your requirements.
FAQObtainQuotesDetails: Request quotes from the providers you've contacted. Once you receive a satisfactory quote, you can approve it to initiate the service.
FAQNeedAssistance: If you encounter difficulties or need further assistance, you can reach out to MosalaPro through their Contact Us page.
FAQDataCollectionAnswer: MosalaPro collects user data to enhance its services and provide a personalized experience. We collect:
FAQPersonalInfoDetails: Your name, email address, and phone number, provided during account creation or profile updates.
FAQDeviceInfoDetails: Data about the device you use to access the platform, including hardware model, operating system, browser type, and IP address.
FAQDataSellingAnswer: We do not knowingly "sell" personal information that we collect from you, in accordance with the definition of "sell" in the CCPA.
FAQPersonalInfoUsage: MosalaPro collects and utilizes your personal information to enhance your experience on the platform:
FAQAccountCreationDetails: To set up and maintain your user profile, allowing you to access various services and features
FAQServiceProvisionDetails: Facilitating connections between users and service providers, ensuring seamless communication and transaction processing
FAQPersonalizationDetails: Tailoring content, recommendations, and services based on your preferences and usage patterns
FAQCommunicationDetails: Sending updates, notifications, and responding to your inquiries or requests
FAQAnalyticsDetails: Analyzing usage data to improve platform functionality, user experience, and service offerings
FAQSecurityDetails: Ensuring user data protection, fraud prevention, and adherence to legal obligations
FAQPackageDescription: Service providers on MosalaPro are required to select a package to access various features and benefits tailored to enhance their visibility and success on the platform, the packages typically offer:
FAQIncreasedVisibilityDetails: Enhanced listing positions or featured spots to attract more clients
FAQClientLeadsDetails: Opportunities to connect with potential clients actively seeking services
FAQMarketingToolsDetails: Resources to promote services effectively within the platform
FAQPackagesSummary: These packages are designed to provide service providers with tools and opportunities to grow their business and reach a broader audience
